professionalSummary: Full Stack Mobile App Developer with 3+ years of professional experience, delivering 4+ production mobile applications for 4+ clients, most serving 1,000+ users. Turns client requirements into well-scoped, maintainable digital products. Experienced in making technical decisions across platforms, languages, databases, integrations, and deployment workflows. Combines hands-on development with clear documentation, practical development standards, risk-aware system design, and structured client communication to improve delivery from discovery through handover. Improved application performance by ~20% and reduced development or deployment time by ~30% through practical delivery practices. Leverages AI tools and APIs to build smarter features, accelerate development, and improve code quality.

description: Developed and maintained client-facing web applications using Wix Velo, JavaScript, and custom backend logic in a production environment.
Built and customized dynamic features such as product pages, search, calculators, and form-based workflows.
Integrated third-party APIs, authentication, and interactive functionality based on project requirements.
Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements, define project scope, and translate needs into clear build plans and maintainable solutions.
Advised on suitable platforms, tools, databases, and implementation approaches based on project requirements and long-term maintainability.
Created and maintained technical documentation, including requirements, implementation notes, setup guidance, and handover information for client and team use.
Improved application stability and maintainability through modular code, debugging, performance optimization, and practical delivery practices.
Managed application deployment and release workflows across web, Android, and iOS environments using GitHub Actions, Vercel, AWS, Google Play Console, and App Store Connect.

Provided clients and team members with implementation guidance and practical best practices, including secure MongoDB data handling, backup planning, and recovery considerations to reduce data-loss risk.
Worked on production web applications, supporting content integration, configuration, and customization using templates and GUI-based tools.
Made minor HTML and JavaScript updates and occasionally modified existing React.js components.
Customized application behavior and content through JSON configuration files.
Collaborated with team members using task tracking and timelines to meet delivery deadlines while following professional reporting standards.
Supported structured team workflows through clear progress updates, coordination, documentation, and timely communication.

projects.title: Hagah
projects.description: Maintained and enhanced a meditation platform across the mobile app, admin panel, and backend services, implementing authentication, premium audio streaming, downloadable audio, playlists, UI/UX improvements, and an AWS-based HLS streaming pipeline that automatically converts uploaded tracks for adaptive playback.

projects.title: Pastors University
projects.description: Built and maintained the learner-facing web app and admin tooling for a pastoral leadership platform, including course access, payments, multilingual content, media workflows, and an AWS-based automated HLS media pipeline integrated with backend APIs.

projects.title: Go Make Disciples (CPI)
projects.description: Built and maintained a faith-based streaming and learning platform spanning mobile, web, and admin applications, implementing subscription-based access to courses, books, and streaming content, an admin book management system, multilingual support, and an AWS-based automated HLS media pipeline integrated with backend APIs.
